provenance: Every event maps to papers/arxiv-1912.07242/trace.jsonl (engine events, real timestamps 21:08-23:21) or to the Omnigent session transcripts (session c62c9b43 / a475c559, exported to runs/omni-session-1912.jsonl). Orchestration events (dispatches, human interventions, provider failures) are annotated source:session. Curated for the demo replay; nothing fabricated.

paper.title: More Data Can Hurt for Linear Regression: Sample-wise Double Descent
paper.tagline: A famous result: test error peaks at n=d. Can an agent lab verify it — and find something the paper didn't claim?

events.title: director takes the paper
events.body: arxiv 1912.07242 · unseen by the pipeline · goal: run the full discovery loop — extract, audit, propose, audit, judge.

events.title: extract
events.body: ./lemma audit 1912.07242 --stages extract

claims.label: test MSE peaks at n = d

events.title: director triages → auditor
events.body: picks C1 (the headline result) + C2 (theorem-level, verifiable closed form). C3–C6 deferred — declared, not skipped.

events.title: C1 · attempt 1
events.body: Monte-Carlo double descent: d=1000, T=50 trials, full n-grid — ~100k least-squares solves.

events.title: C1 · attempt 1 — timeout
events.body: 20:00 wall limit. Preserved as run_attempt1.failed.json.

events.title: C1 · attempt 2 — timeout
events.body: Step-10 n-grid — still ~10k solves at d=1000. 20:00.

events.title: C1 · attempt 3 — timeout
events.body: Same trap: d=1000 again. 20:00. All three failures kept.

events.title: C1 — inconclusive
events.body: Honest output: the test was too expensive, not the claim wrong. 3 failed attempts preserved.

events.title: C2 · attempt 1 — timeout
events.body: 19 gammas × 2000 trials × d=1000 ≈ 38k solves. 20:00.

events.title: C2 · attempt 2 — crash in 1s
events.body: NameError: beta undefined. Kept verbatim in the trail.

events.title: C2 · attempt 3
events.body: d=1000, 19 gammas, T=500 — finishes in 12 min.

events.title: C2 — falsified
events.body: bias rel err 24.2% > 20% criterion · risk 1.8% ✓ var 1.6% ✓ · positive control passed (0.8%) — the measurement is trustworthy.

events.title: human intervention — feedback.md
events.body: Reviewer correction filed for C1 & C2: “the claims are dimension-agnostic — test at d ≤ 300. For an asymptotic formula, show error decay with d, not one huge d.”

events.title: orchestration failure — and recovery
events.body: provider 402 kills session 1 mid-run · auditor sub-agent dead · workdir state preserved → new session on runinfra continues where it left off.

events.title: C1 · re-audit with feedback
events.body: d=200, T=20, dense grid around n=d — 25× cheaper per solve.

events.title: C1 — supported
events.body: peak at n=200 = d exactly · non-monotonic ✓ · control (d=50 → peak at 50) passed · 87 seconds.

events.title: C2 — supported at finite d
events.body: all rel errs ≤ 2% at d=150 · control 0.5% · the 24.2% round-1 bias error was MC noise at d=1000, not a paper flaw · 2 crashed attempts in this round preserved too (7 failures total).

events.title: the feedback effect
events.body: 65+ min unguided → 4.5 min guided. Same engine, same machine — reviewer knowledge changed the cost.

events.title: director → proposer
events.body: result changed the plan: with the approximation verified, what does it predict that the paper didn't test?

events.title: P1 — the risk valley
events.body: the closed-form risk R(γ) = (1−γ) + σ²γ/(1−γ) has a minimum at γ* = 0.90 for σ=0.1. Untested by the paper. Cheap to check: 5-point grid, d=150, T=300.

events.title: C7 promoted to a first-class claim
events.body: kind: generated-hypothesis · source: agent_generated — labeled as agent-originated in claims.json.

events.title: C7 · audit
events.body: MC valley location vs closed form · positive control: σ=0.5, whose valley is analytically at γ*=0.75.

events.title: C7 — supported · 14 seconds
events.body: strict min at γ=0.90 exactly as predicted · rel err 4.1% ≤ 10% · control recovered γ*=0.75 at 1.7% — new verified result, generated by the lab.

events.title: the catch — circularity detected
events.body: C2's round-2 bias check hard-coded E[β̂]=γβ — it verified an identity, not a measurement. The proposer caught it; director disclosed it in the report.

events.title: P2 parked behind human approval
events.body: independent MC check of E[β̂] filed as proposal P2 — not run: consequential next step waits for the human gate.

events.title: every failure preserved
events.body: 7 failed attempts · timeouts · a NameError · provider 402s · a dead sub-agent — all in trace.jsonl, all inspectable.

events.title: evidence + judge
events.body: ./lemma audit 1912.07242 --stages evidence,judge — Trackio logbook assembled (156 trace events).

events.title: judge — PASS 5/5
events.body: structure ✓ evidence ✓ integrity ✓ cost disclosure ✓ trace ✓ — 0 claims silently skipped, all costs logged.

events.title: what the loop changed
events.body: inconclusive→supported · falsified→supported · one agent-generated hypothesis verified · one circular test caught · one follow-up gated on a human.

events.title: paper → verdicts → new result
events.body: ≈2h13m wall including provider outages · re-audit round 4.5 min · generated-hypothesis audit 14 s · every step reconstructible.
